name: @berkes/vormen
description: Vormen is a bag of tools, modules and scripts for creating generative art in SVG using Javascript

tasks.check:all: deno ci && deno check && deno lint && deno fmt --check && deno test --permission-set
tasks.version:minor: deno bump-version minor && git add . && git commit -m'bump version' && git tag "v$(< deno.json | jq .version -r)"
tasks.version:patch: deno bump-version patch && git add . && git commit -m'bump version' && git tag "v$(< deno.json | jq .version -r)"
